concept: Review and integration: what it means to be a thoughtful question-asker so far
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Of asking why, checking what's true, and slowing down to think — which do you want to practice most?
exercise.practice: Student summarizes, in their own words, what being 'wise' means so far

assessment.success_marker: student offers a personal definition connecting to at least one prior story
